import re

with open(r'C:\Users\jathi\workspace\amigos\docs\api-specification\03_master_dtos.md', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    content = f.read()

# 1. Update Common Response Fields
content = content.replace(
    'Every `SummaryResponse` should contain:\n- `id`\n- `code`\n- `name`\n- `is_active`',
    'Every `SummaryResponse` should contain exactly:\n- `id`\n- `code`\n- `name`\n- `is_active`\n\n*Rule: Summary DTOs contain only commonly displayed fields. Do not include additional business fields.*'
)

content = content.replace(
    '- `description`\n- `display_order`\n- `audit_info`',
    '- `description`\n- `display_order`\n- `version`\n- `audit_info`'
)

# 2. Update Audit Rules
content = content.replace(
    'Only `DetailResponse` includes `audit_info`.\nAutomatic audit updates:',
    'Only `DetailResponse` includes `audit_info`.\nCurrently, `created_by` and `updated_by` use simple UUIDs. Do not expand them into nested user objects.\nAutomatic audit updates:'
)

# 3. Update Validation Rules (code)
content = content.replace(
    '- **code**: uppercase, unique, letters/numbers/underscore only\n',
    '- **code**: uppercase, unique, letters/numbers/underscore only. No spaces.\n'
)

# 4. Add Optimistic Locking rule before '---' above Master Modules
content = content.replace(
    'business workflow logic.\n\n---\n\n# Master Modules',
    'business workflow logic.\n\n### 32. Optimistic Locking\nTo prevent concurrent update conflicts, every master entity must support optimistic locking using a `version` integer field or checking `updated_at`. For phase 1, we include `version` in DetailResponses.\n\n---\n\n# Master Modules'
)

# 5. Common Audit Information Example
content = content.replace(
    '"audit_info": {',
    '"version": 1,\n    "audit_info": {'
)

# 6. Destination DTOs changes
content = content.replace(
    '| state | string | Yes | Max 100 | Kerala |',
    '| state_id | uuid | Yes | Valid FK | uuid |'
)
content = content.replace(
    '| country | string | Yes | Max 100 | India |',
    '| country_id | uuid | Yes | Valid FK | uuid |'
)
content = content.replace(
    '"state": "Kerala",\n    "country": "India",',
    '"state_id": "uuid-state",\n    "country_id": "uuid-country",'
)

# 7. Summary response fixes
content = content.replace(
    '"code": "SUV",\n    "capacity": 6,\n    "is_active": true',
    '"code": "SUV",\n    "is_active": true'
)
content = content.replace(
    '"code": "KL",\n    "country_id": "uuid-country",\n    "is_active": true',
    '"code": "KL",\n    "is_active": true'
)
content = content.replace(
    '"code": "GST",\n    "percentage": 5,\n    "is_active": true',
    '"code": "GST",\n    "is_active": true'
)

# 8. Add version to all DetailResponses where audit_info is present, except the common one which we already did via replace.
# The common one was already replaced by #5. The regex will hit the others.
content = re.sub(
    r'"is_active": true,\n\s*"audit_info": \{',
    '"is_active": true,\n    "version": 1,\n    "audit_info": {',
    content
)

with open(r'C:\Users\jathi\workspace\amigos\docs\api-specification\03_master_dtos.md', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(content)

print('File updated successfully.')
